feedback: Robin's confession follows the available contradiction and supplies the precise sequence of taking poison at preview and returning after the interview. Those actions were not independently witnessed before voting, but they explain an already viable opportunity rather than introduce a new identifying fact. The confession earns its emotional ending by distinguishing her act from the claimants' legitimate request, which was present in the petition from the start. Barb's badge and Chip's surrendered keys give consequences to their admitted failings without pretending they committed the murder. I found it satisfying, although the exact poison-knowledge link still rests more on inference than on a clearly quoted card. The finale confirms the deduction instead of rescuing it.
